subject: Weekend throttle buffer: temporary credit top-up request for Beacon POC
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@beacon.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary credit buffer for weekend throughput run

Hey Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We have a tight window this weekend to validate 24h night-window behavior under production-like traffic (mainly high-concurrency inference calls to the chat endpoint). The plan (attached) simulates sustained bursts and a short 2-hour peak that will exercise batching and KV-cache behavior.

Quick ask: can Redwood provision a temporary trial top-up (ephemeral credits) for Beacon so we can run the 8–12 hour soak plus a 2-hour peak? We estimate ~3M tokens total (20–30k requests/hour). We don’t want the test to throttle if we hit the safety limits.

Attachments: Beacon_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, nightwindow-loadplan.csv

High level acceptance: we’ll run in your hosted test tier, won’t expose PII, and we’ll share telemetry afterwards. If you need a PO or an MAA, we can expedite.

Can you confirm by EOD today? We’re aiming to start Saturday 02:00 PDT.

—Alex
Alex Chen
Platform Engineer, Beacon AI
alex@beacon.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@beacon.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 09:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit buffer for weekend throughput run

Alex —

Thanks — and nice plan. I’ll run this up for a short-term buffer. Looping Karthik (sales ops) for the credit authorization and Marissa (billing) for the accounting side.

Quick note on numbers: can you confirm final estimated token volume and whether you want the buffer as credits or an overage waiver for the weekend? Either is fine on our side; credits are faster.

If Karthik/Marissa are good, we can apply an ephemeral credit today to avoid any throttling during the run.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit buffer for weekend throughput run

Jordan / Marissa —

Reviewed Beacon’s load plan and the MAA draft. Given the short window and the non-production data posture, I approve an ephemeral credit allocation. Proposed guardrails:
- Grant 60k USD-equivalent in trial credits (enough headroom for ~3–4M tokens under their model).
- Set a hard throttle at 72 hours or when spend hits the 60k cap (whichever comes first).
- Require a short telemetry postmortem from Beacon by Monday 10:00 PDT (simple csv + a short notes doc).

If Marissa can apply the credit today, we’ll notify Beacon and mark the deal as test-supported (DEAL-8742).

Karthik

Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 18:10:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit buffer for weekend throughput run

Alex / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan. We’ve applied a one-time ephemeral credit of $60,000 to Beacon AI’s trial account (internal ref: DEAL-8742 / CREDIT-3071). The credit is active immediately and will auto-expire after 72 hours or on use of the full amount, whichever occurs first.

What we did:
- Added $60k trial credit to Beacon’s hosted tenant
- Created a hard spend cap at $60k to prevent accidental overuse
- Enabled alerting to Jordan + Karthik at 80% and 95% of the credit consumption

Next steps for Beacon: please run the soak and send the telemetry CSV and a brief run summary to sales-ops@redwood.com by Monday 10:00 PDT so we can close the test support record. If you want extended credits after the run, we can discuss a paid pilot.

Alex — confirmation link to the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8742 (internal). DocuSign link for MAA (if needed): https://docusign.com/s/MAA-8742

—Marissa
